description: Finite authored world-fixed silhouette ring for a visual-only parallax experiment. All values are uncalibrated design units; this is not a reconstruction, not a metric scale and not a navigable destination.

sky.note: Static sky background drawn at infinity; it does not parallax under camera translation and provides the fixed backdrop for the finite ring.

collision.note: The finite horizon ring has no collider, no floor and no implied route. The camera path is an authored inspection path, not traversal.

camera_path.note: Bounded horizontal inspection path. No player/character controller is added to either scene.

parallax.note: Panel 18 sits near -Z, directly ahead of both same-orientation views. Its horizontal angular shift between translate_a and translate_b must exceed the threshold; the sky background shift is zero by construction.

source_reference.role: visual context only; not modified, not admitted, not registered
